title: left-pad is deprecated
summary: The package author recommends the built-in String.prototype.padStart method.

constraints: Preserve target width, fill-string behavior, string coercion, and handling of values already wider than the requested length.

steps.title: Replace left-pad calls
steps.instructions: Convert each reported call to String(value).padStart(length, fill) while preserving existing coercion and defaults.

steps.title: Remove the dependency
steps.instructions: Delete left-pad from package metadata and refresh the lockfile.

verification.purpose: Run padding edge cases and repository tests when defined.
Verify the project builds without left-pad.
